retrievalProfile.description: A nostalgic 1970s aesthetic featuring a central photograph framed by a thick, warm-toned border with custom Art Nouveau-inspired serif typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A central rectangular photograph with rounded corners, depicting two men in light-colored vintage attire walking in front of a large white southern-style mansion, framed by a thick, textured orange-red border containing decorative line-work and stylized serif text.
coreVisualRelationships: Centralized subject framed by a dominant color border
High-key white clothing against a natural green and white architectural background
Symmetrical tree canopy framing the top of the inner image
Warm color palette unified by the orange border and golden-hour lighting
coreInvariants: Thick outer border in a warm, saturated hue

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two central figures at medium-full scale, walking toward the viewer on a path.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The white pillared mansion in the background provides a stable, symmetrical anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the top text, moves down through the tree canopy to the figures, and rests on the bottom title.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The wide orange border acts as significant negative space to focus attention on the central scene.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Burnt orange/Red-orange border providing the primary mood.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white of the mansion and clothing against the green lawn.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep greens and browns in the foliage and tree trunks.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the border contrasts with the slightly desaturated, hazy quality of the central photograph.

letterConstructionRules: High contrast between thick and thin strokes
Elongated, swash-like terminals on capital letters
characterSpecificRedesigns: S and G with extended, curving tails that integrate into the border lines
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single decorative typeface used for both branding and title to maintain 70s consistency.
graphicDevices: Thin black keyline around the photo

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the 70s soft-rock aesthetic and curved terminals.
Provides the appropriate vintage decorative feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a soft-focus 1970s style photograph of two men in white suits walking in front of a white southern mansion, framed by a thick burnt-orange border with rounded corners.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add black Art Nouveau-style serif text at the top and bottom center, enclosed in thin double-line decorative flourishes.

verificationChecks: Is the border a warm orange-red?
Are the inner corners of the photo rounded?
Is the typography stylized with 70s swashes?
Does the photo have a vintage film grain/haze?

adjustableVariables: Architectural style of the background house
mustRedesign: Identifiable faces of the original duo

mustAchieve: Integration of text within the border design

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the orange border is thick and dominant.
Check that the tree branches frame the top of the inner image naturally.
Verify the text is black and uses a high-contrast serif font.
Confirm the overall image feels like a physical 1970s vinyl sleeve.
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a central vintage-style photograph + wrap in a thick warm-toned border + add rounded corners + insert swash-heavy serif text into line-art cartouches.
